comments.author: @IceMetalPunk
comments.text: One thing I'm not clear on: what defines the robot's goal? It sounds like each model is super fine-tuned to be so narrow it will just repeat the same task in the same location over and over, but can't do anything else without training a new model? If so, I'm not sure that's really the future of autonomous robots. I feel like our progress with LLMs/LMMs should be on track to usher in an era of robots where goals themselves are general -- a prompt of "hey, bot, do this thing" -- and the AI figures out the steps to execute the task. As opposed to custom models tailored to every task, which is more like the narrow AI we had pre-2018, but in a bot brain.
